title: Step 61-F specifications, related content and add-to-cart
description: Complete Product Detail commercial/supporting content using existing canonical contracts only: render ProductSpecificationView data, source related products from the typed primary-category listing endpoint rather than placeholder related/recommendation routes, and wire the selected sellable variant to the existing authoritative guest Cart API. Store guest cart capability credentials only in server-managed HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies; never expose cart_token to client JavaScript. Preserve Cart/Pricing/Inventory business rules and keep checkout/cart-page behavior reserved for Step 63.

dependencies.name: Media gallery, video and capability boundary

evidence.cart_boundary: Existing POST /cart and POST /cart/{id}/items remain authoritative; no Cart/Pricing/Inventory source mutation.
evidence.related_placeholder_debt: /products/{slug}/related and /recommendations have no runtime controller/typed payload and are not consumed.
evidence.related_source: GET /categories/{slug}/products using canonical primary category and ProductCard.

acceptance_criteria.description: Product specifications render canonical name/value/unit data with explicit empty state and no parallel specification DTO.

Related content uses typed GET /categories/{slug}/products for the canonical primary category, excludes the current product, preserves backend order, reuses ListingGrid/ProductCard and does not consume placeholder related/recommendation endpoints.

Selected variant add-to-cart calls existing POST /cart and POST /cart/{id}/items with quantity 1 and backend-authoritative sellability/stock enforcement; no Cart/Pricing/Inventory rule is reimplemented.
Guest cart id/token remain server-managed host-only HttpOnly SameSite=Lax cookies (Secure on HTTPS); cart_token is never returned to or stored by client JavaScript.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront spec-related-cart:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront auth:verify

acceptance_criteria.description: Only invalid cart capability access may create replacement guest credentials; stock/global-sales/variant/checkout failures remain authoritative errors.

Historical Step61 C/D verification is migrated only for the downstream related/cart handoff; original Product Detail, variant, price, availability and no-frontend-authority assertions remain enforced.
acceptance_criteria.verification: pnpm --dir apps/storefront product-detail-foundation:verify && pnpm --dir apps/storefront variant-price-stock:verify

acceptance_criteria.description: No backend/OpenAPI/database/dependency/current-state/design-contract mutation and no cart page/checkout/payment implementation occurs.

Canonical completion requires root pnpm verify, exact-head Canonical CI, Phase A, Storefront quality, deterministic Review, exact-artifact ACTIVE Lock, protected merge, exact-SHA postmerge verification and terminal Lock release before 61-G.

external_gate_evidence.rule: Stage 61-F is MEDIUM risk because it changes Storefront-only presentation/server bridge and consumes but does not modify the authoritative Cart/Catalog domain. Direct-main write/raw merge are prohibited.
